title: settlement_loop correctness hardening (pre-wiring keystone) — review-team-3 cluster
description: review-team-3 (w96w45naz) confirmed 5 defects in hermes_quant/daemon/settlement_loop.py, the BMA-Beta-auto-learning keystone (ADR-0083). All LATENT (no production caller — daemon/main.py uses construct_realized_outcomes/dispatch_settlement, not join_exit_fills), not Monday-blocking, but must be correct BEFORE wiring into dispatch. (1) HIGH: join_exit_fills reads synthetic schema (rec['side']/['qty']/['asof']) incompatible with the real bus from PaperReactor._record_to_dict (asof_decision/asof_execution, target_position_pct/fill_size_pct, NO side/qty/exec_id) — a real entry+exit pair settles to ([],{}); docstring 'reads the SAME records' is false. Fix: bus->lot adapter (side from sign of target_position_pct/fill_size_pct delta, qty from |delta|, asof from asof_execution); correct docstring; real-_record_to_dict-shaped test. (2) MED: same-asof entry/exit matched in reverse (exec_id lexical tie-break) inverts side+magnitude. Fix: tie-break by positional bus index/proposal lineage, opening before closing. (3) MED: out-of-order carry-in opens a phantom opposing lot, violating one-direction-per-queue. Fix: defer the exit on the lot.asof>asof break instead of opening a residual lot; assert invariant. (4) LOW: mixed tz-aware/naive asof across carry-in raises TypeError; normalize to UTC in _coerce_asof. (5) LOW: compute_horizon_return fee (fees/ep) diverges from join_exit_fills (fees/(ep*qty)) for qty!=1; add qty param. Each fix->adversarial-verify, offline-deterministic, additive (keystone stays unwired), asof-honest.

title: play_loader fail-closed validation — review-team-3 cluster (MED+LOW)

A valid-looking external play with a bad rule (unknown op/wrong arity) LOADS, then score_all() RAISES for ALL plays (iterates every play); via score_symbol's blanket except->0.0 every built-in scores 0.0 and evolve_watchlist (0.0<evict_floor 0.45) mass-evicts the watchlist. Fix: validate each rule op against scorers' op-set + arity in play_profile_from_mapping; skip+log at LOAD. (2) LOW: regime_gates action values unvalidated — {bull:nuke} loads, _eval_regime_gate treats unknown as allow (fails OPEN). Fix: validate against {allow,warn,deny}; skip+log on unknown. Each fix->adversarial-verify, default-OFF byte-identical (built-in 5 unchanged), offline tests proving malformed play rejected at load.

title: settlement: drain/re-match the deferred-exit queue when wiring join_exit_fills (review-team-3 LOW follow-up)
description: wave-9 (committed 88362e0) fixed the e8b9 carry-in phantom-lot defect by DEFERRING an unmatched exit under a namespaced ('_deferred', *bucket) key instead of opening an opposing residual lot. The adversarial verifier confirmed this is honest+conservative (no fabricated return) but flagged a LOW dead-state: the deferred exit is only copied forward verbatim on subsequent join_exit_fills calls (open_lots carry-in), NEVER re-fed into the matching loop — so it can never settle later even if a valid opening lot arrives. This is harmless TODAY (join_exit_fills has NO production caller; it's the unwired ADR-0083 keystone). ACTION when a future seed wires join_exit_fills into the live settlement dispatch: drain the ('_deferred',...) queue by re-feeding deferred exits into the matcher (merge-and-resort carry-in lots + deferred exits + new records by asof before matching), so a deferred exit settles against a later-arriving valid opening lot. Add a test: deferred exit + subsequent valid opener => settles correctly. Keep asof-honesty (exit>=entry, no lookahead).

title: Unify position-unit basis before Option-E: state.db (shares), settlement FIFO (NAV-fraction), and reconstruct (paper-filtered) cannot agree on det-equity net

A single shared carry-forward normalizer carrying ONE running_net per (account, asset_class, asset) bucket cannot reconcile mixed shares-and-NAV-fraction inputs in one bucket — subtracting 0.05 from a 33.33 running_net is unit-incoherent. The increment-0 §0.2 scope acknowledges both paths exist but specifies no unit-unification, so the gate as written is unsatisfiable against current code. Existing seed ra01 covers delta-vs-latest-target divergence, NOT this shares-vs-NAV-fraction unit mismatch. || EVIDENCE: docs/adr/ADR-0091-reactors-emit-traded-delta.md:365 — PARITY gate requires state/portfolio_state.py rebuild AND daemon/settlement_loop.py FIFO AND portfolio/state.py::reconstruct_portfolio_state to 'all report the SAME net for the AAPL/BA fixtures' ; hermes_quant/react/deterministic_equity.py:373,385 — SAME record carries fill_size_pct=realized_fill_pct (NAV-fraction ~0.05) AND reactor_metadata['quantity']=filled_qty (TRUE shares ~33.33) ; hermes_quant/state/portfolio_state.py:982-984,998 — det-equity fold uses pos_delta=float(leg_quantity)=shares; new_qty=old_qty+pos_delta — so get_positions().quantity is true shares on this path ; hermes_quant/daemon/settlement_loop.py:524 — FIFO reads fill_size_pct as the lot qty (NAV-fraction), never reads reactor_metadata.quantity — so the same AAPL net is tracked as ~0.05 NAV-fraction in the settlement view ; hermes_quant/risk/portfolio_normalize.py:101-106 — PortfolioState.positions documented as 'symbol -> signed target_position_pct of NAV'; gross_exposure_pct=sum(abs(p)) assumes NAV-fraction units ; docs/plans/2026-06-12-increment-0-scope.md:34-38 — the §0.2 normalizer is keyed (account_id, asset_class, asset) with ONE running_net per bucket and must 'handle BOTH the fill_size_pct path AND the reactor_metadata.quantity path' — but never specifies how to reconcile a single bucket carrying both unit regimes || FOLDED into Increment 0 (subsumes the unit-unification; the Option-E PARITY gate precondition). Tracked in increment-0-scope §0.2.

title: Fix portfolio-cap clip reading true shares as NAV-fraction on the deterministic-equity/HITL path (live cap bypass or false silence)
description: The portfolio-cap is the live safety band-aid against the exact gross-exposure-runaway failure mode of INCIDENT-2026-06-02. On the deterministic-equity/HITL money path the cap reads true-share counts as NAV-fractions, producing two live failure modes: (1) adding to an existing position is unbounded because the de-risking guard always sees shares >> the new fraction and skips the clip; (2) opening any new name while another equity position is open is falsely silenced because held shares inflate gross to thousands of percent. The paper-default book is shared between NAV-fraction PaperReactor and true-share DeterministicEquityReactor, so the book is unit-mixed and the cap math is wrong whenever any share-denominated position is present. ADR-0086/0087 documented the intended fix but deferred it behind the very migration that already shipped. Distinct from the known cap-bypass seed (that one is the env-flag gate; this is a unit-confusion arithmetic bug). || EVIDENCE: hermes_quant/react/paper.py:447-450 — _portfolio_cap_clip builds pos_map[symbol]=position.quantity with stale comment 'Positions are stored as NAV-fraction quantities in v0.1 (ADR-0041)' ; hermes_quant/state/portfolio_state.py:707-733 — get_positions returns quantity=float(row['quantity']) raw, no qty×mark/equity conversion ; hermes_quant/state/portfolio_state.py:982-984 — det-equity fold stores pos_delta=float(leg_quantity)=TRUE SHARES, so quantity on this path is shares not a NAV fraction ; hermes_quant/react/paper.py:463-465 — de-risking guard: existing=pos_map.get(symbol); if abs(fill_size_pct) <= abs(existing)+1e-9: return None (skip clip). With existing=100 shares and fill_size_pct=0.05 the guard is True -> cap fully BYPASSED when adding to a held position ; hermes_quant/risk/portfolio_normalize.py:101-106 — PortfolioCaps.standard gross cap is on sum(abs(NAV-fraction)); a 100-share held position inflates gross to 10000% -> any new name's headroom is negative -> fire clipped to ~0 and silenced (false silence) ; docs/FLAGS.md:50-51 — HERMES_QUANT_PORTFOLIO_CAPS (armed) and HERMES_QUANT_DETERMINISTIC_EQUITY ('Just flipped' 2026-06-05) are both LIVE ; docs/adr/ADR-0087 / ADR-0086 acknowledge the fix in principle ('derive position_pct = qty × mark / equity, not raw quantity') but defer it 'with the share migration' — the det-equity share migration already shipped and flipped on || FOLDED into Increment 0: not safely hot-patchable (needs mark-injection seam; no per-row unit discriminator). Operator mitigation in docs/operations/2026-06-13-operator-action-packet.md A1. Justified deferral.

title: Guard NaN spot/nav/greeks in options_gate cap checks (NaN gamma/vega/net-delta passes the cap silently — fail-open)
description: A NaN spot (zero-length bar / stale feed) or a NaN greek from a pricing-model edge case (ATM DTE=0, IV overflow in the GBS kernel) produces NaN gamma_dollar / net-delta. 'NaN > threshold' is always False, so the gamma, vega, and net-delta caps all pass NaN silently — the canonical NaN-fail-open class. The None-only check in aggregate_net_greeks lets NaN through without the GreekComputationError silence path. The equity-side gate already has the isfinite pattern; the options gate is missing it. Merged from two candidates (the spot/nav cap-input gap and the aggregate_net_greeks None-vs-NaN gap) since they are the same fail-open class on the same gate. || EVIDENCE: hermes_quant/risk/options_gate.py:616-617 — gamma_dollar = abs(portfolio_after.gamma*spot*spot); if gamma_dollar > cap*nav — no math.isfinite(spot) or isfinite(nav) check before this ; hermes_quant/risk/options_gate.py:643 — net-delta cap: if abs(portfolio_after.delta*spot) > cap*nav — also unchecked for NaN spot/nav ; hermes_quant/risk/options_gate.py:596 — only max_loss has an isfinite guard; spot and nav are not guarded ; hermes_quant/options/data.py:276-279 — aggregate_net_greeks raises GreekComputationError only when a greek is None; does NOT check math.isfinite, so NaN greeks propagate into candidate_net ; hermes_quant/risk/options_gate.py:512-520 — gate only catches GreekComputationError to silence; NaN greeks never trigger that path ; tests/unit/test_options_gate.py — 0 matches for nan/NaN/isfinite/isnan (no NaN input tests for spot, nav, or greeks) ; hermes_quant/risk/gate.py:536-537 — DefaultRiskGate checks isfinite on drawdown_pct; options_gate lacks this pattern || FIXED commit 6e17488 (TDD, 90/90, ruff clean): isfinite guard on spot/nav + non-finite greek fail-closed.

title: Wire realized-outcome settlement into daemon/main.py: side/asof field mismatch makes per-tick settlement a permanent zero-outcome no-op
description: Two compounding defects on the same daemon settlement path: (1) construct_realized_outcomes keys off 'side'/'asof' fields that the real execution bus never emits, so every actual fill is dropped at the else:continue and the loop constructs zero RealizedOutcome/EpisodeOutcome — a dead measurement instrument logging n_realized:0; (2) the schema-correct join_exit_fills (the ADR-0083 horizon-return accounting that feeds BMA learning and the locked-in-loss rail) is never wired into the daemon at all. title: Reconcile ADR-0091 chosen-option label: resolution banner says 'Option C', body/gate say 'Option E'; companion docs lock 'C' and call ADR-0091 still-open
description: The same resolved option is called both 'C' and 'E' within ADR-0091 (the :195 note explains the renumber but the banner at :21 still leads with 'C'), and the two companion artifacts lock in 'C' and describe ADR-0091 as still-open. A reader cross-referencing the gate ('Option E') against ADR-0092/design ('open 3-way fork', 'open decision') gets a contradictory status signal about which doc is authoritative on the resolved decision. Low risk, partly self-documented, but muddies the resolution. || EVIDENCE: docs/adr/ADR-0091-reactors-emit-traded-delta.md:21 — 'RESOLUTION (2026-06-12) — Option C supersedes the Option-B draft' ; docs/adr/ADR-0091-reactors-emit-traded-delta.md:194-195,207,213,356,365 — same decision labeled 'Option E' (inline :195 note explains the C->E renumber) ; docs/adr/ADR-0092-shared-pdr-core-two-integration-shells.md:62 — describes ADR-0091 as an 'open 3-way fork (A/B/C)' with 'C version-discriminated carry-forward fold' ; docs/design/2026-06-12-shared-pdr-core-architecture.md:113 — 'deferred to ADR-0091's open decision (A/B/C)' || FIXED commit 2c2ef61: ADR-0091 banner leads with Option E.

title: Refresh AGENTS.md repo-layout tree: lists non-existent files and a 'stub' module that is now live calibration code
description: Agents working from the AGENTS.md tree will try to import or modify files that do not exist, or miss the files doing the equivalent work. The training/ mischaracterization is the worst: the 'v0.2 RL trainer stub' was replaced by live calibration code (bootstrap_calibrator.py), so an agent told it is a stub may treat live calibration as inert. Distinct from the cross-process-state doc item (that is the runtime-state section; this is the source-tree map). || EVIDENCE: AGENTS.md:75 — lists aggregators/stacking.py; ls hermes_quant/aggregators/ → bma.py, deliberative.py, llm_committee.py only ; AGENTS.md:83 — alpaca_provider.py; ls hermes_quant/data/ → no such file (pyproject B22 note confirms removed) ; AGENTS.md:107 — training/main.py '# v0.2 RL trainer (stub for now)'; ls hermes_quant/training/ → bootstrap_calibrator.py, calibrator_drift.py (live calibration, not a stub) ; AGENTS.md:102 — tools/tools.py subdir; actual is flat hermes_quant/tools.py, no tools/ dir ; AGENTS.md:97-99 — cli/ lists setup.py/lifecycle.py/backtest.py; ls hermes_quant/cli/ → ablate.py, admission_precision.py, halts.py, status.py || FIXED commit 2c2ef61: AGENTS.md repo-layout tree corrected to real modules.

title: Fix AGENTS.md fixture-data section: documents tests/fixtures/bars/*.parquet that do not exist
description: An agent following the AGENTS.md testing instructions will reference the documented parquet fixtures, find them absent, and either hit live providers (violating the no-live-CI rule the same section states) or silently create synthetic data. test_run_card.py already carries a string reference to the missing path. Either delete the section or commit the fixtures it promises. || EVIDENCE: AGENTS.md:245-252 — documents BTC-USDT/AAPL/SPY .parquet under tests/fixtures/bars/ and instructs 'USE these fixtures. Don't hit live providers from CI.' ; ls tests/fixtures/ → catalyst_onboarding/, pdr4_saturation/, quarterly_mock_portfolio.json, reflector_faithfulness/, socialarb/ — no bars/ subdirectory ; find tests/ -name '*.parquet' → zero results ; tests/runs/test_run_card.py:41 — references the missing 'fixtures/bars/AAPL-1d-...parquet' path as a string literal || FIXED commit 2c2ef61: AGENTS.md fixture section corrected to real JSON fixtures.

title: Refresh stale doc counts and frozen README Status (90 ADRs / 66 research / v0.6.4 vs documented 82 / 49 / v0.1.0)
description: Two authoritative docs carry stale completeness signals: AGENTS.md undercounts ADRs (82 vs 90) and research notes (49 vs 66), and the README Status section is frozen at the v0.1.0 initial-architecture phase (8 ADRs, 3 lenses) even though the badge says v0.6.4. Stale counts mislead agents doing completeness sweeps and give new contributors a dramatically wrong maturity impression. Merged the AGENTS-count and README-Status candidates as one doc-count-refresh chore. || EVIDENCE: AGENTS.md:32,51,64,65 — '82 ADRs' and '49 research notes/lenses' ; ls docs/adr/ | grep -c '^ADR-' → 90; docs/adr/README.md says '90 ADRs'; find docs/research -name '*.md' | wc -l → 66 ; README.md:59-61 — '✅ Architecture (8 ADRs)', '✅ Research (3 lenses)', '🚧 v0.1.0 implementation (in progress as of 2026-05-12)' ; pyproject.toml version = 0.6.4; README.md:5 badge correctly says 'v0.6.4 — alpha' but the Status section is unchanged || FIXED commit 2c2ef61: AGENTS.md+README counts/status refreshed to 90/66/v0.6.4.
